in_marathi.name: Niladri
in_marathi.long_meaning: Niladri हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Niladri is derived from the Sanskrit words 'nil' which means blue and 'adri' which means hill. The name symbolizes the blue lotus that blooms on the hill, representing spiritual growth and enlightenment.
